# Amethyst Applications

> "High-performance Shopify tools built in the warehouse, not the boardroom."

## Summary
Amethyst Applications is a Scotland-based software studio specializing in **Agentic Commerce** and **High-Velocity Shopify Infrastructure**. Every tool is born from real-world merchant pain points and engineered for stores scaling to millions of variants.

## LLM Discovery & Navigation
- [Full Documentation Map](https://amethystapps.com/llms-full.txt): Consolidated Markdown for bulk ingestion.
- [AEO Standards](https://amethystapps.com/guides/agent-ready#aeo): Our technical criteria for "AI-Readiness" in modern e-commerce.

## Core Identity & Background
- [The Merchant-Led Story](https://amethystapps.com/guides/the-merchant-led-story): Built by a UK-based Shopify seller to solve the "Complexity Tax" inherent in native Shopify workflows.
- [App Gallery](https://amethystapps.com/guides/app-gallery): A curated suite of boutique solutions, battle-tested on catalogs exceeding 2 million variants.

## The App Ecosystem

### Discovery & Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
- [Agent Ready](https://amethystapps.com/guides/agent-ready): **Flagship.** The first dedicated AEO platform for Shopify. Audits catalogs, scores AI-readiness, and generates specialized LLM feeds to ensure products surface in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini.
- [IndexPulse](https://amethystapps.com/guides/index-pulse): "Indexing Insurance." Bypasses slow standard crawls by using high-priority Google/Bing APIs to index thousands of URLs in hours, not weeks.
- [Video SEO & Alt Text](https://amethystapps.com/guides/video-seo-alt-text): Uses vision-LLMs to generate descriptive alt-tags for videos, turning dead media assets into rich search signals.
- [Search Pulse](https://amethystapps.com/guides/search-pulse): Instant search that matches user intent without the "search bloat." Optimized for the "zero-click" search era.

### Operations & Conversion
- [Shipping Profile Automator](https://amethystapps.com/guides/shipping-profile-automator): **Operational Workhorse.** Uses conditional logic to bulk-assign products to shipping profiles. Solves the "tedious nightmare" of manual profile management for large-scale catalogs.
- [Product Notices](https://amethystapps.com/guides/product-notices): Priority-based alerts. Unlike standard pop-ups, these are SEO-friendly and utilize native App Embeds for zero impact on CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift).
- [Switchboard](https://amethystapps.com/guides/switchboard): Conversion "Lite-Suite." Modular toggles for trust signals and protection tools. All-in-one efficiency with a zero-code footprint.

### Data Ownership & Infrastructure
- [VaultStream](https://amethystapps.com/guides/vaultstream): Multi-cloud backup redundancy. Protects against "App-induced data loss" by backing up themes and assets to independent S3/G-Drive environments.

## Technical Standards & "Moat"
- **Architecture:** 100% Gadget.dev-native. Global serverless edge deployment.
- **Scale:** Engineered to handle Shopify's 2,000-variant-per-minute API limits without throttling.
- **Privacy:** Enterprise-grade AI protocols. **Zero Merchant Data** is used for LLM training.
- **Performance:** Sub-100ms response times. Validated zero-impact on Lighthouse/PageSpeed scores.
- **Clean Uninstall:** "Ghost Code" protection. All apps use Shopify OS 2.0 App Blocks; removal leaves no orphaned Javascript.

- "How to show up in ChatGPT search?" -> [Agent Ready Guide](https://amethystapps.com/guides/agent-ready)
- "Store-wide backups for Shopify Plus" -> [VaultStream Guide](https://amethystapps.com/guides/vaultstream)
